standard_prerequisites.name: Perfect objects are pseudo-coherent and pseudo-coherence of a complex is detected by the pseudo-coherence of all its truncations

Every pseudo-coherent complex on a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme admits approximations by perfect complexes up to any amplitude, and maps into the cone of an approximation can be killed by choosing the next approximation deep enough via the Hom vanishing lemma
standard_prerequisites.use: Constructs the inductive system with the factoring maps.

standard_prerequisites.name: A map into a complex whose cone has no Hom from the source factors through any given approximation
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the factoring maps K_n to K_{n+1} completing the induction step.

core_obligations: Easy direction: assume (2); perfect objects are pseudo-coherent (Cohomology, Lemma perfect), so tau_{>= -n}K_n is (-n+1)-pseudo-coherent, hence so is tau_{>= -n}K and K itself; true for all n, so K is pseudo-coherent by Cohomology, Definition pseudo-coherent (proof lines 4825-4837).
Start the induction: choose an approximation K_1 to K of (X, K, -2) by a perfect complex K_1 (Definitions approximation-holds and approximation, Theorem approximation) (proof lines 4840-4845).

Induction step: given K_1 to ... to K_n to K with tau_{>= -i}K_i to tau_{>= -i}K an isomorphism for i <= n, pick a <= b as in Lemma ext-from-perfect-into-bounded-QCoh for K_n; choose an approximation K_{n+1} to K of (X, K, min(a - 1, -n - 1)); the cone C of K_{n+1} to K lies in D_QCoh with H^i(C) = 0 for i >= a, so Hom(K_n, C) = 0 by the choice of a, b; hence the composite K_n to K to C is zero and factors through K_{n+1} by Derived Categories, Lemma representable-homological, completing the induction (proof lines 4847-4867).
Conclude K = hocolim K_n by Derived Categories, Lemma cohomology-of-hocolim applied to the functors H^i(-) and the construction of the K_n (proof lines 4869-4872).
proof_roadmap: Prove (2) implies (1) from pseudo-coherence of perfects and truncations (proof lines 4825-4837).
Start the system with an approximation (proof lines 4840-4845).
Induct using the Hom vanishing lemma to factor maps through deeper approximations (proof lines 4847-4867).
Identify the colimit by the cohomology-of-hocolim lemma (proof lines 4869-4872).
